Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal public‑holiday long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in BC, etc.—you’ll have to add those separately.)

| Long‑weekend | Holiday(s) | Dates (2023) | Notes |
|--------------|------------|--------------|-------|
| **New Year’s** | New Year’s Day (observed) | **Sat Jan 1 – Mon Jan 3** | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1; it was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** | Family Day is a provincial holiday; it fell on Monday Feb 20. |
| **Good Friday** | Good Friday | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** | Good Friday is a federal holiday; it fell on Friday Apr 7. |
| **Victoria Day** | Victoria Day | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | Victoria Day is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday May 22. |
| **Canada Day** | Canada Day (observed) | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1; it was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Labour Day** | Labour Day | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** | Labour Day is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Thanksgiving | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Remembrance Day (observed) | **Fri Nov 10 – Sun Nov 12** | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday Nov 11; it was observed on Friday Nov 10. |
| **Christmas** | Christmas Day | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | Christmas Day fell on Monday Dec 25; it created a long weekend from Saturday Dec 23. |

### Quick Summary

- **Total federal long weekends in 2023:** 9  
- **Longest stretch:** 3 days (any of the above)  
- **Shorter stretches:** 2 days (e.g., if a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday but the adjacent weekend day is not a holiday)

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario on Friday Mar 17, St. George’s Day in BC on Friday Mar 17, etc.), let me know and I can add those as well.
